title: Power BI Report Server Report Load Time p95
dataSources: Power BI Report Server execution log (`powerbi:reportserver`).
app: Power BI Report Server ExecutionLog via DB Connect and service logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:reportserver status="Success"
| eval dur_s=round(duration_ms/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by report_path
| where p95_s>10
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile load time for each report in Power BI Report Server and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Power BI Report Server reports by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Power BI Report Server timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest reports with their owners.
visualization: Table of report by p95 load time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Power BI Report Server so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
